archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast / Authority) customized for premium SaaS and Bespoke Chemical Industry

headings.notes: No giant titles (e.g., 'Dashboard'). Use clean, contained headings with a professional tone.

kpi_cards.style: bg-white rounded-[18px] p-6 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02),_0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] transition-all duration-250 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]
kpi_cards.icon_container: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-[#0B8F5A]/10 text-[#0B8F5A]
kpi_cards.growth_indicator: inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-green-600 bg-green-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full w-fit

buttons.primary: bg-[#0B8F5A] text-white hover:bg-[#066A43] font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-sm

charts.style: Modern, smooth lines (monotoneX or spline). Minimal grid lines.
charts.gradients: Subtle fill gradients under lines (e.g., #0B8F5A fading to transparent at the bottom).
charts.tooltips: Modern, white background, soft shadow, minimal clean text, no heavy borders. Use Recharts with customized tooltip content.

icons.usage: Always place inside a colored circular container in cards. No loose/floating icons.

animations.notes: Keep it subtle. Do not exaggerate. Hover state should elevate the card slightly.

images.description: User profile avatar for the TopBar
Modern clean chemical laboratory background, useful for Auth/Login screen or hero banners if needed.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format, representing the role (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-producao-link', data-testid='kpi-card-producao-hoje').

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js or .jsx extensions for React files. Do not use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Replace generic dashboard templates with this highly custom styling.
Implement the Exact CSS Variables into frontend/src/index.css under :root.
Configure tailwind.config.js to include Geist/Inter fonts and the custom colors (#0B8F5A, #066A43, #164E63).
Create an AppLayout component wrapping Sidebar (left) and TopBar (top). The main content area MUST have bg-[#F5F7FA] or bg-[#F8FAFC].
Ensure Sidebar items match the exact categories requested: GERAL, PRODUÇÃO, LABORATÓRIO, ESTOQUE.
KPI cards must strictly follow the requested structure: 18px border radius, extremely soft shadow, circular colored icon container, large value, description, and growth indicator.
Apply Recharts for charts with smooth monotone lines, no grid lines (or very faint dashed), and a subtle gradient fill.
Do not add any 'Dashboard' giant header title. Let the KPI cards lead the visual hierarchy.
Add transition-all duration-250 ease-out on cards with hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg for the 0.25s subtle interaction.
